The '''Douz outpost''' was a settlement established on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It consisted of a few bleached dome-roofed buildings often found in cities across Tatooine. By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the outpost had its own power station, where [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] could be supplied with energy, and was equipped with a few [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]].<ref name="LCOT" />
